title: Window Name Default Element Color
description: Window names should use element gray as default, not emphasized foreground; emphasize on hover/active only.
summary: Window tab names default to text-element instead of emphasized foreground. Added modeDockTabClassName; removed text-foreground overrides for stack-active tabs in inactive stacks; aligned modeDockActiveTabFillClass with hover fill + text-emphasized for globally active tabs; updated drag preview label color.
